// Variables carry the context of the call that uses them; bare documents are classified by shape.
use shop

const pipe = [{ $group: { n: { $sum: 1 } } }, { $out: "x" }, { $limit: 1 }]
const filter = { $or: [] }
let proj = { a: 1, b: 0 }
var upd = { plain: 1 }
const sortSpec = { a: 3 }
const unusedVar = [{ $out: "z" }, { $limit: 1 }]
const objectOnly = { a: { $gtt: 1 } }

db.orders.aggregate(pipe)
db.orders.find(filter, proj)
db.orders.updateOne({ _id: 1 }, upd)
db.orders.find({}).sort(sortSpec)
db.orders.countDocuments(filter)
db.orders.aggregate(pipe)
db.orders.find(undeclared, alsoUndeclared)

// bare pipeline arrays
[{ $match: { a: 1 } }, { $out: "x" }, { $limit: 1 }]
[{ $match: { a: 1 } }, { $group: { _id: "$k" } }]
[{ a: 1 }, { b: 2 }]
[]

// bare single-stage object
{ $match: { a: { $gtt: 1 } } }
{ $limit: 0 }
{ $group: { n: 1 } }

// bare update-like object
{ $set: { a: 1 }, $inc: { n: "x" } }
{ $pushAll: { a: [1] } }
{ $unset: { a: 1 }, $setx: { b: 1 } }

// bare query-like object (lenient: expression operators tolerated)
{ a: 1, a: 2 }
{ $gt: 5 }
{ $sum: 1, a: 1 }
{ $match: { a: 1 }, $limit: 3 }
{ $set: { a: 1 }, b: 2 }
{ }
{ a: { $in: 5 } }

// chain and member shapes
db["my-coll"].find({ a: { $nee: 1 } })
db.getCollection("x").aggregate([{ $out: "y" }, { $limit: 1 }])
db.orders.find({ a: { $gtt: 1 } }).sort({ a: 5 }).limit(2).skip(1)
db.orders.aggregate([{ $match: { a: 1 } }]).toArray()
db.orders.aggregate([{ $limit: 0 }]).forEach(printjson)
db.orders.explain("executionStats").find({ $or: [] })
db.orders.estimatedDocumentCount()
db.adminCommand({ ping: 1 })
sh.status()
